vo/d02.mp3.text: Route approved by someone who has not seen it.

vo/d03.mp3.text: Customer requested a contactless delivery. Try the door first.

vo/d34.mp3.text: Reminder: the shortcut is optional. So is your dignity.

vo/d35.mp3.text: Your load has been rated: probably fine.

vo/d33.mp3.text: Dispatch here. Please drive like the boxes are watching. They are.

vo/d04.mp3.text: Package has selected a new address.

vo/d05.mp3.text: Your shipment is exploring its options.

vo/d06.mp3.text: One parcel has declined the itinerary.

vo/d37.mp3.text: We are now a two-stop delivery.

vo/d36.mp3.text: A parcel has left the vehicle. It did not say goodbye.

vo/d10.mp3.text: That strap would like a word.

vo/d09.mp3.text: We are calling that a distribution exercise.

vo/d11.mp3.text: The cargo has started leaning into its career.

vo/d12.mp3.text: Load security is now a philosophical question.

vo/d14.mp3.text: That was either skill or a very expensive coincidence.

vo/d15.mp3.text: The road is going to take this personally.

vo/d16.mp3.text: Contents may have shifted. Confidence has not.

vo/d18.mp3.text: This side up has been renegotiated.

vo/d20.mp3.text: Your order is now marine freight.

vo/d39.mp3.text: For the record, the boxes did not consent to that.

vo/d22.mp3.text: The pool is not an approved receiving department.

vo/d40.mp3.text: Please do not use the pool again. That was in the note.

vo/d23.mp3.text: The underside looks great, for what that is worth.

vo/d24.mp3.text: Please return the vehicle to its original orientation.

vo/d41.mp3.text: Driver has entered horizontal mode. Stand by.

vo/d42.mp3.text: The vehicle has chosen to live here now.

vo/d26.mp3.text: Excellent vehicle delivery. Wrong vehicle delivery.

vo/d27.mp3.text: You have passed the point. Literally.

vo/d28.mp3.text: The brake pedal has requested a meeting.

vo/d31.mp3.text: The flamingo is pursuing independent work.

vo/d44.mp3.text: Flamingo has been released into the wild. It will be fine. It is plastic.

vo/d32.mp3.text: You appear to be shipping in installments.

vo/d45.mp3.text: Dispatch did not see that. Dispatch would like to un-see that.

vo/d46.mp3.text: Altitude is not a delivery metric. But go on.

vo/d47.mp3.text: Rooftop access confirmed. Liability not confirmed.

vo/d50.mp3.text: Driver is fine. Driver is filing a report about the driver.

vo/d51.mp3.text: Same route. Same boxes. Brand new optimism.

vo/d52.mp3.text: Dispatch admires your commitment to the bit.

vo/d53.mp3.text: The fragile one. Of course it was the fragile one.

vo/d54.mp3.text: Front wheel is taking a personal day.

vo/p01.mp3.text: Pier Pressure. Mind the gulls. They are unionized.

vo/p02.mp3.text: You are now on the snack stand roof. The snack stand has not been informed.

vo/p03.mp3.text: The ocean is not a receiving department either. We checked.

vo/h01.mp3.text: HOA No. Keep it under a reasonable speed. They will not tell you what that is.

vo/h02.mp3.text: You are driving on a garage. A complaint has been drafted.

vo/h03.mp3.text: That is somebody’s koi pond. Was.

vo/r02.mp3.text: All accounted for. Nobody act surprised.

vo/r01.mp3.text: Remarkably, the contents and the packaging agree.

vo/r03.mp3.text: Everything arrived. Some of it in a new shape.

vo/r05.mp3.text: Three out of five. Technically a majority.

vo/r04.mp3.text: Most of your order is here. Emotionally, all of it.

vo/r06.mp3.text: One parcel is taking the scenic route.

vo/r07.mp3.text: Four parcels and a compelling explanation.

vo/r09.mp3.text: The tracking number is now more of a suggestion.

vo/r12.mp3.text: New personal best. Please do not update company policy.

vo/r13.mp3.text: Faster than last time. We will leave it at that.

vo/r14.mp3.text: An uneventful delivery. In this economy.

vo/r15.mp3.text: Signed for by: the deep end.

vo/r17.mp3.text: Recipient was not home. Neither, briefly, was the vehicle.

vo/b01.mp3.text: SlingMods dispatch. Your parts are out for delivery. Probably.

vo/b04.mp3.text: Package received. Receipt printing. Nobody look at the receipt.

vo/b05.mp3.text: Dispatch update: not enough boxes left to pass. You may continue for practice. And for sport.

vo/b06.mp3.text: Welcome to the loading dock. Please choose your mistakes carefully.
